Coverage_Description: Customizable group medical plan covering inpatient and surgery, pre-admission and post-discharge follow-up, hospital cash benefit and accidental injury extra compensation; optional critical illness inpatient top-up, outpatient (including dental), maternity and 24-hour global emergency support, subject to benefit schedule limits.
customer requirement: Hong Kong-registered company with at least 3 full-time employees; employee must hold HK/Macau ID or valid work visa; if dependants are covered, all eligible spouse and unmarried children must join.
price structure: Annual premium in HKD; premium rate reviewed at each policy anniversary; insurance levy applies.
additional informations: 1-year term with guaranteed renewal; over 3,000 network providers with medical-card cashless/claimless outpatient service; online outpatient claims up to HK$5,000 can be approved as fast as 1 working day.
